corrected_activation_kurtosis_published: Final-prompt J-lens logit excess kurtosis across 129 fixed prompts; published lens. Solid clean, dashed corrected online-current sequential k=10 lesion. Medians and pointwise 95% country-cluster bootstrap intervals (2,000 resamples; prompt-weighted median). This describes readout concentration, not a compensating circuit. Model-specific norm/head are used with the stated lens matrices.
corrected_lesion_severity_published: Paired final-prompt residual norm ratio and cosine under published lens for the same 129 prompts. Medians with pointwise country-cluster 95% intervals. States are captured after lesion hooks; differences include preceding lesions. Comparable severity can constrain simple intervention shrinkage, but does not establish exact span erasure.

corrected_prompt_space_cka_primary: Prompt-space activation CKA for corrected primary, using the published lens intervention. Each square compares decoder layers within one condition using centered linear CKA on the ordered 129 final-position residuals. Differences subtract the displayed condition matrices; they are not cross-model CKA. Both seed figures share color scales. Global organization does not prove causal rerouting.
